scenarios.title: Stable baseline
scenarios.description: System remains in normal operating envelope with slow correlated movement.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Neraium remains below warning threshold and threshold baseline never fires.
scenarios.proof_statement: Stable baseline: Neraium warning at cycle None, threshold first trigger at cycle None, lead=None.

scenarios.title: Gradual relational drift
scenarios.description: Cross-signal structure drifts steadily before any single sensor crosses a hard threshold.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Neraium warning appears before threshold trigger with smooth risk progression.
scenarios.notes: Primary investor storyline for early warning advantage.
scenarios.proof_statement: Gradual relational drift: Neraium warning at cycle 33, threshold first trigger at cycle 80, lead=47.

scenarios.title: Abrupt disturbance / spike
scenarios.description: Short-lived transient perturbation should not permanently escalate systemic risk.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Signal may blip but should recover; no sustained escalation.
scenarios.proof_statement: Abrupt disturbance / spike: Neraium warning at cycle 50, threshold first trigger at cycle None, lead=None.

scenarios.title: Progressive degradation to critical
scenarios.description: Long, compounding degradation eventually crosses hard operational thresholds.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Neraium warning appears materially earlier than threshold baseline.
scenarios.proof_statement: Progressive degradation to critical: Neraium warning at cycle 26, threshold first trigger at cycle 60, lead=34.

scenarios.title: Missing / messy data
scenarios.description: Dropouts and partial windows stress data quality handling and uncertainty reporting.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Engine remains explicit about uncertainty and avoids unsafe confidence jumps.
scenarios.proof_statement: Missing / messy data: Neraium warning at cycle 26, threshold first trigger at cycle None, lead=None.
